rationale: itnet_v3-claude-agentic: itnet_k=2, unet_c=24, alpha_init=0.005, lr=0.00021567, epochs=5, batch_size=2, train_n=2400, val_n=200, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=1100, seed=42, rationale=iter-11 (breast-ct redo, search-20260703-01). START FROM iter-7 CHAMPION (c24/ep5/lr2.16e-4/alpha0.0025734, hr 0.8469). ONE KNOB: alpha_init 0.0025734 -> 0.005 (~2x, stronger initial DC step size). All else = champion exactly (itnet_k=2, unet_c=24, lr=2.16e-4, epochs=5, batch_size=2, train_n=2400, val_n=200, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS): (1) lr is now BRACKETED and UNIMODAL at the seed: iter-10 lr1.5e-4 -> 0.8415, iter-7 lr2.16e-4 -> 0.8469 (CHAMPION), iter-9 lr3.5e-4 -> 0.8398. Both lr neighbors are worse -> lr=2.16e-4 is the recipe optimum (iter-10 falsifier fired). (2) FAILURE MODE / lever: the last un-tuned training-recipe knob is alpha_init -- the DC step size the unrolled loop uses in dc_step (x <- x - alpha * R^T(Rx - sino)). It is learnable (softplus(log_alpha)) but its INIT sets the optimization path; it has been fixed at the TPE-seed 0.0025734 since iter-1. A larger init -> stronger sinogram data-consistency pull early in training, which can sharpen the 128-view breast recon. (3) ONE KNOB: alpha_init 0.0025734 -> 0.005 (~2x). c/k/lr/epochs/train_n held so any hr change isolates the DC-step init. (4) HYPOTHESIS: alpha_init=0.005 lifts hr above 0.8469 because a stronger initial DC coupling enforces measured-sinogram consistency better on this sparse 128-view geometry. FALSIFIER (NUMBERS): if hr <= 0.8469 at alpha_init=0.005, the learnable alpha already converges to its optimum regardless of init (init is inert) OR a stronger DC over-weights the noisy sinogram -> iter-12 tries a LOWER alpha_init (0.0015) or, if that is also flat, declares the training recipe exhausted and does a seed-robustness replicate of the champion. (5) BUDGET (HARD 20min=1200s): IDENTICAL config to iter-7 except the alpha_init scalar (no compute change) -> elapsed ~= 900-1090s = 15-18min < 1200s. max_train_s=1100 fences the TRAIN phase. train_n=2400 (<= OOM-safe cap). val=200 distinct val_truth.h5 cases, 256px inscribed-circle FOV (breast default). (6) do NOT return control mid-campaign; gate on iter-11 numeric-headroom obs via iter_wait.sh v3 then dispatch iter-12.
